description: This Java class implements the StatisticsShardConfig interface, representing configuration details for a statistics shard within the system. It includes methods for creating instances from configuration data, retrieving properties, and standard overrides like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultStatisticsShardConfig
classes.description: An immutable class implementing StatisticsShardConfig that holds configuration for a statistics shard, including shard, role, and root identifiers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultStatisticsShardConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string, always 'shards'.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on shard, role, and root values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on shard, role, and root.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration instance.
